# Gold (XAU/USD) briefing — None SGT

Price is $3887.6, +2.3 (+0.06%) compared with yesterday's close of 3885.3.
Current read: LEAN BEARISH. Gold is leaning slightly DOWN. Because it's +0.06% compared with where it finished yesterday, and in the last hour it's been going up (+0.05%), and today's headlines lean bad for gold (2 bad vs 1 good).
Today's range: low $3858.8 to high $3989.0. Price is 22% of the way up that range ($28.8 above the low, $101.4 below the high).
Trading sessions open right now: New York. Next: New York closes in 186 minutes.
Measured from the last two days of 1-minute data, gold moves most in these hours (SGT): 21:00 (5.9 pips/min), 09:00 (4.6 pips/min), 22:00 (4.2 pips/min).

The US dollar is basically flat today, so it is not the thing pushing gold around right now.
